findings: Auth form flash before redirect — an already-authenticated user loading /auth directly sees the login form briefly before the useEffect redirect fires. Guard by returning null while isValidating is true or while isAuthenticated && !isValidating.

Low-confidence response uses HTTP 200 — POST /predict returns { success: false, status: "unrecognized" } with HTTP 200 for below-threshold images. Any consumer that checks only the HTTP status code will silently treat this as a successful prediction. Use HTTP 422, or document the contract explicitly.

Revoked tokens stay live on network error — AuthContext keeps the user authenticated when /api/auth/validate fails with a network error at startup. A server-revoked token is invisible to the app until the next successful backend round-trip. Consider a maximum offline grace period.
